describes: The environment in which the frozen QRS 2026 data was successfully replayed
is_not: A record of the original experiment environment. Nothing in this file may be copied into ORIGINAL_EXPERIMENT_METADATA.json. The original host environment was never recorded and remains not_recorded there.

platform.note: Recorded at the granularity needed to reproduce numeric results. Linux CI is expected to produce the same tables; that expectation is verified by the research-regression workflow, not asserted here.

scanner_not_exercised.note: The replay recomputes tables from frozen run records and does not invoke Checkov, so the local 3.3.0 installation cannot influence the result. Any workflow that re-executes the scanner must pin 3.2.517.

result.canonicalisation_applied: CRLF->LF plus exactly one trailing newline
result.figures_note: No frozen analysis script calls savefig; the three committed PNGs are not reproduced by this replay and are protected by the byte manifest instead.
